description: This file defines the CacheListener interface used for cache event notifications such as key removals, additions, and updates in the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: CacheListener
classes.description: Interface for listening to cache events like key removal, addition, and update.

methods.name: noteKeyRemoval
methods.description: Method invoked when a key is removed from the cache.

methods.name: noteKeyAddition
methods.description: Method invoked when a new key is added to the cache.

methods.name: noteKeyUpdate
methods.description: Method invoked when a key's value is updated in the cache.
